text: {"label":"Variables affecting equivalence class formation","definition":"Experimental research on training, testing, and stimulus variables, such as meaningful stimuli, preliminary training, limited hold, and match-to-sample alternatives, that influence whether and how stimulus equivalence classes form, merge, or expand.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on specific procedural and stimulus variables that facilitate class formation, rather than contextual control and naturalistic derived relations, broad conceptual issues in equivalence, or acquisition of conditional discriminations."}
